boot.failedDescription: Kutup could not be reached, or signing in through your account did not finish. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

timeline.title: Photos
timeline.failedTitle: Your library could not be loaded
timeline.failedDescription: Kutup could not be reached. Check your connection and reload the page.
timeline.emptyDescription: Upload photos and videos, or drop them here. Photos you already keep in Drive show up once you add their folders in Settings.

upload.drop: Drop photos and videos to upload them
upload.noFolder: Your upload folder could not be made. Try again.
upload.notMedia_one: {{count}} file was left out: only photos and videos go into the library.
upload.notMedia_other: {{count}} files were left out: only photos and videos go into the library.

selection.downloadFailed: The download did not finish. Try again.
selection.tooLargeForBrowser: This download is too large for this browser. Use Chrome or Edge, or download fewer at a time.
selection.trashDescription_one: It goes to the trash of the Drive folder it is in, and can be restored from there.
selection.trashDescription_other: They go to the trash of the Drive folders they are in, and can be restored from there.
selection.trashSome_one: {{count}} selected item is someone else's and stays.
selection.trashSome_other: {{count}} selected items are someone else's and stay.
selection.trashFailed_one: {{count}} item could not be moved to trash
selection.trashFailed_other: {{count}} items could not be moved to trash
selection.markFailed: This could not be saved. Try again.

viewer.videoTooLarge: This video is too large to play here. Download it to watch it.
viewer.failed: This could not be opened. Try again, or download it.
viewer.cannotDraw: This browser cannot show this format. Showing its preview; download the original.
viewer.showingPreview: Showing a preview: the original is too large to open here.
viewer.cannotPlay: This browser cannot play this video. Download it to watch it.

info.dateUnknown: Not known. It is sorted by when it was uploaded.
info.placeShared: Anyone who can see this photo can see where it was taken.
info.mapsOff: Maps are off. Turn them on to see places on a map.
info.caption: Caption

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Photos are Drive files. Choose where uploads go and which folders your library shows.
settings.saveFailed: This could not be saved. Try again.
settings.uploadDescription: New photos and videos go here. It is one of your own folders in Drive.
settings.uploadNotYet: Until you choose, a folder named {{folder}} is made in My files on your first upload.
settings.libraryDescription: The upload folder is always in your library. Add other folders, yours or shared with you, to see their photos here too.
settings.subfolders: A folder's subfolders are part of it. Removing a folder from the library leaves its photos in Drive.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.emptyDescription: Mark photos with the heart to find them here. Favourites are yours alone, even for photos shared with you.

archive.title: Archive
archive.emptyDescription: Archived photos stay in your library and in Drive, out of the timeline and Places.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.emptyDescription: Hidden photos show only here: not in the timeline, Favourites, Archive or Places. They stay in Drive.

edit.title: Edit details
edit.description: When and where it was taken, and a caption. Saved encrypted with the photo: anyone who can see it sees them.
edit.pickOnMap: Click the map to choose where it was taken
edit.pickHint: Click the map to set the place, or type its coordinates.
edit.mapsOff: Maps are off: type the coordinates.
edit.caption: Caption
edit.invalid: Check the date and the coordinates.
edit.failed: The details could not be saved. Try again.

places.mapsOff: Turn maps on to see where your photos were taken. Places come from your photos' encrypted details and are put on the map on this device.
places.none: None of your photos has a place yet. Photos taken with location on show up here.
places.moveMap: Move or zoom the map to see photos here.
places.noneShort: No photos with a place yet.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Photos and videos moved to the trash of your folders. The trash is Drive's: restoring puts them back where they were.
trash.failed: The trash could not be loaded
trash.emptyDescription: Other files and whole folders in the trash are in Drive.
trash.deleteDescription_one: It is deleted with its versions and thumbnails, and frees its space.
trash.deleteDescription_other: They are deleted with their versions and thumbnails, and free their space.

albums.title: Albums
albums.description: Albums gather photos from anywhere in your library. A photo stays where it is in Drive; putting it in albums copies nothing.
albums.name: Album name
albums.emptyDescription: Make one here, or select photos in Photos and choose Add to album.
albums.failed: This could not be done. Try again.
albums.addDescription: Only your own photos go in albums; they stay in your storage.
albums.emptyAlbum: Select photos in Photos and choose Add to album.
albums.deleteDescription: The album goes. Its photos stay in your library and in Drive.
albums.leaveDescription: You will no longer see it. The photos you put in leave with you.

share.title: Share {{name}}
share.description: People on this server see the album's photos. With Can add photos, they put in their own, which stay in their storage.
share.email: Email of someone on this server
share.notHere: No account on this server has that email.
share.failed: This could not be done. Try again.
share.linksHint: Anyone with a link sees the album's photos, without an account. The key is in the link, never on the server.

public.note: Shared with a link. The photos are end-to-end encrypted; this page opened them in your browser.

failure.missingKey: The link is incomplete: its key is missing. Ask for the whole link.
failure.notFound: The link does not exist, or the album was deleted or the link removed.
failure.badKey: The link's key does not open this album. Ask for the whole link.
failure.notAlbum: This link is not to an album.
